newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says work needed in united Germany.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says work needed in united Germany.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl said in a speech released on Tuesday that there was still a lot of work to do in rebuilding the formerly communist east.

"Everyone knows that there is still a lot of work that has to be done in a united Germany. The reconstruction of the new states will take many years and take great efforts," he said in the speech which is to be broadcast on television on Thursday.

Kohl said that Germany had earned worldwide admiration for its peaceful unification on October 3, 1990 and singled out the courage of East German citizens who had taken to the streets to press their demand for freedom in the fall of 1989.
"Our joint efforts in building up the new (eastern) states are admired around the world," Kohl said in the speech to mark the sixth anniversary of German unification.
Thursday has been a national Unity Day holiday since 1990. Kohl will be on an official visit to Ireland on Thursday.
Kohl, referring to lingering tensions between west and east Germans, said there was much that linked the two.
"Germany is in spite of its problems a prosperous nation," Kohl said. "If we all work hard, it will stay that way...We are joined by hundreds of years of history, by our language and by our culture."
